question: What powers and responsibilities were granted to Panchayati Raj Institutions through the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992?.

options.text: Direct control over the armed forces in rural areas
Power to override state legislations in matters of local importance

solution:
The correct answer is __**Constitutional status and protection**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 granted **constitutional status** to Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs), ensuring their legitimacy and protection under the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Act added **Part IX** to the Constitution, titled "The Panchayats," and introduced the Eleventh Schedule, listing 29 functional areas</strong&g
